scripts.render: node sound.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.41 render --resolution portrait-4k --fps 60 --quality delivery -o renders/tutorial.mp4 && npm run web
scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -i renders/tutorial.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -crf 19 -preset slow -tune animation -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart ../public/tutorial.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -ss 3.4 -i renders/tutorial.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos -q:v 2 ../public/tutorial-poster.jpg
